titulo: MEU EX CASOU COM MINHA AMIGA
personagens: Cecilia, a Brazilian woman around 30 with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, mustard cardigan over a white top; her ex-boyfriend, a man around 32 with short black hair and a light beard; her former roommate, a woman around 30 with curly auburn hair in a bun and a green dress
cenario: a cozy city apartment and a neighborhood community center in warm afternoon light
cenas: Cecilia sitting on her sofa holding a smartphone, stunned, the screen glowing with a wedding photo of a smiling bride and groom
Cecilia at her window with the phone pressed to her chest, lost in thought, moving boxes stacked behind her
Cecilia opening an elegant wedding invitation with a handwritten dedication card, her face more confused than angry
Cecilia pacing her living room, phone in hand, a framed old photo of two roommates laughing on the shelf
Close on Cecilia reading a long heartfelt message from her friend on the phone, eyes softening
Cecilia sitting at the kitchen table with a cup of coffee, thinking calmly before reacting
Flashback-style scene of the ex-boyfriend and the friend meeting for the first time at a neighborhood charity drive, sorting donation boxes
Cecilia listening carefully on a video call with her friend, both looking sincere and a little sad
Cecilia typing a short kind reply on her phone at a sunny balcony, a closed wedding invitation beside her
Years later, Cecilia and her friend sharing a quiet coffee at a cafe table, smiling politely, a respectful distance between them
